remarks: Two bedroom, two bathroom Fractional Ownership located on the 4th floor of the premier Tamarack Club. This owner ship gives you 10-11 rotating weeks per year, or about 1 week per month. Located on the slope/golf course side of the building giving you great views in all seasons. Ownership amenties include year 'round access to the pool and hot tubs, sauna, fitness center, private locker rooms, private owners lounge, valet parking, and underground garage parking while lodging overnight. Discounts available for golfing and skiing with your owner's card.
